questions.stem: Which eminent French anatomist is recognized as the 'Father of Histology' for defining 21 distinct tissue types without microscopic aid?
questions.explanation: Xavier Bichat coined the term 'tissue' and classified 21 primary tissues.

questions.stem: Microscopic investigation of animal tissues was first systematically pioneered by which Italian biologist?
questions.explanation: Marcello Malpighi pioneered microscopic histology and discovered capillaries.

questions.stem: In animal phylogeny, true tissue level of organization first evolved in which invertebrate phylum?
questions.explanation: True tissue grade organization originated in Coelenterates (e.g. Hydra).

questions.stem: Which structural biological hierarchy correctly progresses from microscopic elements to whole organism?
options: A) Cell -> Organ -> Tissue -> Organ System -> Organism
B) Cell -> Tissue -> Organ -> Organ System -> Organism
C) Tissue -> Cell -> Organ -> Organ System -> Organism
D) Organ -> Tissue -> Cell -> Organism -> Organ System
questions.answer: B) Cell -> Tissue -> Organ -> Organ System -> Organism
questions.explanation: Biological hierarchy: Cell -> Tissue -> Organ -> Organ System -> Organism.

questions.stem: How many principal primary tissue classes constitute the somatic structure of complex multicellular animals?
questions.explanation: Animal soma comprises 4 primary tissues: Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Nervous.

questions.stem: Which germ layer gives origin to connective tissue and muscular tissue during embryonic gastrulation?
questions.explanation: Connective tissue and muscular tissue originate from embryonic mesoderm.

questions.stem: Which primary tissue type exhibits all three embryonic germ layer origins (Ectoderm, Mesoderm, Endoderm)?
questions.explanation: Epithelium derives from all 3 germ layers (Ectoderm epidermis, Mesoderm endothelium, Endoderm gut lining).

questions.stem: The branch of biological science dealing with the microscopic study of tissue architecture is named:
questions.explanation: Histology is the microscopic study of tissues (coined by Mayer).

questions.stem: The non-cellular adhesive basement membrane underlying epithelial cell sheets is composed of:
options: A) Basal lamina and Reticular lamina
questions.answer: A) Basal lamina and Reticular lamina
questions.explanation: Basement membrane = Basal lamina (epithelial origin) + Reticular lamina (connective origin).

questions.stem: Which primary tissue type covers external body surfaces and lines internal visceral organs?
questions.explanation: Epithelial tissue forms protective covers and linings across body surfaces and organs.
